newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Monday, dealers said.
They expect the July options expiry on Friday to spur liquidation of the front month, but the trade should remain a steady scale-down buyer.

Friday, the benchmark October futures eased 0.02 cent a lb on the day, to 11.32 cents, having traded from 11.22 to 11.40, a life-of-contract high. Spot July ended down 0.07, at 11.42, with trades posted from 11.32 to 11.51.
The July-October switch shrunk to 0.10 cent by the close, from 0.15 on Thursday.
An estimated 32,219 lots changed hands on the day.

LIFFE white sugar futures were slightly lower in thin Monday trade, with the front October contract down $0.30 to $324.00, at 0842 EDT/1242, spot August stood $0.30 firmer at $324.00, while the back months were trading $0.20 higher to $0.30 lower.
